notes: Final frames captured from the rendered Teaser-16x9 (4K), one per storyboard panel, for side-by-side comparison with storyboard v2.

panels.title: Cold open
panels.action: Frame 105 (3.5 s). Dark studio of floating screens; a warm light beam sweeps across them. Screens pulse on the first kick (3.5 s).
panels.onScreenText: A design studio that runs on Claude
panels.audio: Drone swell + riser; first kick at 3.5 s

panels.title: Title slam
panels.action: Frame 170 (5.7 s). Six words land on 8th notes (4.25–5.5 s); gold rule draws under them.
panels.onScreenText: Design at the speed of thought
panels.audio: Kicks on quarters, ticks on word landings

panels.title: Storyboard to screen
panels.action: Frame 340 (11.3 s). Sketch frame appears; APPROVED stamp hits on the 9.0 s beat; wipe reveals the rendered 4K frame.

panels.title: Every format
panels.action: Frame 440 (14.7 s). Five format tiles land on beats: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, A3 print, each with its true pixel size.

panels.title: End card
panels.action: Frame 540 (18.0 s). Final hit at 16 s: wordmark punches in, gold rule draws, CTA, fade to black.
